codes.name: Add 10000 Money
codes.effect: Adds 10000 ReptiCash to the player balance.

codes.name: Add 10000 EXP
codes.effect: Adds 10000 XP to the player and can trigger level-up rewards.

codes.name: Skip All Buildings
codes.effect: Immediately completes all active habitat build and upgrade timers.

codes.name: Skip All Pairings
codes.effect: Immediately finishes all active breeding pairings and resolves them to ready or failed.

codes.name: Skip All Incubations
codes.effect: Immediately completes all active incubations and marks eggs as ready to hatch.

codes.name: Add House Access
codes.effect: Adds the house biome to unlocked_biomes, granting immediate access to House.
